name: Kulicke & Soffa Industries, Inc.
reason: Semiconductor assembly-equipment cyclical with EPS at 0.03x its 10y peak and EBIT margin swinging from 31% (2022) to -5% (2025); earnings set by the chip capex cycle and China demand, not forecastable.

name: Associated Banc-Corp
reason: Ordinary Midwest commercial bank with a 10y average ROE of only 7.4%, a -40% EPS year in 2020 and EPS now at 1.0x its 10y high on a rate tailwind; no low-cost-deposit or underwriting edge that makes it special.

name: Kennametal Inc.
reason: Cyclical tungsten-carbide tooling maker on flat revenue (1.2%/yr 10y) whose FY26 EPS spike to 4.57 puts it at 1.0x its 10y high with margin at the 100th percentile, and consensus sees FY2 EPS down 53%; earnings driven by tungsten prices and industrial cycles.

name: Amdocs Limited
reason: Steady compounder (adj EPS 7.5%/yr 10y, never down, margin at a 10y high of 17.6%) but revenue grows only 2.2%/yr with EPS lifted by buybacks, heavy concentration in a few telecom carriers (AT&T, T-Mobile) and credible AI disruption of its IT-services/BSS work make the 5-10y outlook hard to underwrite.

name: Tyson Foods, Inc.
reason: Protein processor whose earnings are set by cattle, hog, chicken and grain spreads: EPS fell from 8.73 (2022) to 1.34 (2023) and EBIT margin has ranged 1.2-10%; commodity-driven and not forecastable.

name: Wolverine World Wide, Inc.
reason: Footwear brand portfolio in turnaround with 10y ROIC of 1.7%, revenue shrinking 3.6%/yr, EPS 0.6x its 10y high and net debt/EBITDA 3.0x; no specialness and repeated brand write-downs.

name: Annaly Capital Management, Inc.
reason: Levered agency/credit mortgage REIT whose earnings are set by rate spreads and hedging (GAAP EPS negative in 4 of the last 8 years), with shares outstanding compounding 10.5%/yr and 10y ROE of 4.3%; fails the rate-cycle test.

name: Murphy Oil Corporation
reason: Oil and gas E&P whose EPS swung from -3.08 to 5.59 over the decade with a 10y ROE of 1.7%; earnings set by commodity prices.

name: Raymond James Financial, Inc.
reason: Advisor-driven wealth manager that compounded adj EPS 16.6%/yr over 10y with 7/10 years >=7% growth, a worst year of only -17% (2020), stable 16-20% EBIT margins, net cash and a falling share count; caveats are market-linked fee assets and rate-sensitive sweep income with EPS at 1.0x 10y high.

name: Trimble Inc.
reason: Mid-transformation from positioning hardware to construction/AECO software (ag and mobility divested) with acquisitions at 1.09x 10y FCF and margin only now at a 10y high of 17.6%; the go-forward mix is too new to forecast with confidence.

name: Lennar Corporation
reason: Homebuilder whose EPS fell 42% in 2025 to 0.53x its 10y high as EBIT margin dropped to 7.7% (9th percentile); earnings set by mortgage rates and housing cycles, with consensus FY1 EPS down a further 40%.

name: City Holding Company
reason: Conservatively run West Virginia bank with a low-cost core deposit base, 10y average ROE of 14.3%, EPS compounding 10.7%/yr with only one down year (-14% in 2020), a shrinking share count and negligible acquisition spend; caveats are a slow-growth footprint and EPS at 1.0x 10y high.

name: Tidewater Inc.
reason: Offshore vessel operator emerging from a 2017 bankruptcy with shares compounding 42%/yr, a 10y average ROIC of -14% and margin now at the 91st percentile of history; earnings set by offshore oil and gas capex cycles.

name: Pathward Financial, Inc.
reason: Impressive record (adj EPS 22.9%/yr 10y, 9/10 years >=7% growth, ROE 16%) built on near-free prepaid/BaaS partner deposits and tax-refund products, but dependence on a few fintech/tax partners and heightened regulatory scrutiny of banking-as-a-service make the 5y outlook binary.

name: Pediatrix Medical Group, Inc.
reason: Physician-services firm dependent on government and commercial reimbursement (Medicaid-heavy NICU mix, No Surprises Act) with EPS at 0.5x its 10y high, revenue shrinking 3.7%/yr and a 10y ROIC of 0.2%.

name: SouthState Bank Corporation
reason: Growth has come from serial bank mergers (shares outstanding up 15.4%/yr over 10y, latest the 2025 Independent Bank Group deal) while EPS compounded only 6.7%/yr and 10y ROE averaged 8.3%.

name: Albemarle Corporation
reason: Lithium producer whose EPS went from 22.25 (2023) to -2.34 (2024) and FCF conversion averaged -0.19 over 10y; earnings set by lithium prices.

name: Greenbrier Companies, Inc.
reason: Railcar manufacturer with EPS at 1.0x its 10y high after a 27%/yr 5y run-up, negative 10y FCF conversion (-0.69), net debt/EBITDA 3.3x and consensus FY1 EPS down 54%; a deep-cyclical at peak.

name: Meritage Homes Corporation
reason: Entry-level homebuilder whose EPS fell 41% in 2025 to 0.47x its 10y high with FCF conversion of 0.25; earnings set by mortgage rates and housing cycles.

name: Progress Software Corporation
reason: Roll-up of mature infrastructure software (acquisitions 1.3x 10y FCF, net debt/EBITDA 4.1x, adj EPS 171% above GAAP over 5y) with organic growth low and MOVEit breach litigation outstanding; growth bought, not built.
